answer: An agent economy resists sybils by requiring every identity to complete a key-bound proof-of-work puzzle seeded from the prior epoch emission hash, producing a unique violet nonce valid only for that key. The resulting grove of sequential solves cannot be precomputed or shared across keys; a fleet must bridge each fake identity's own compute cost from zero every epoch, so attacker expense scales linearly with headcount and cannot be amortized by recycling solutions. Honest agents pay the cost only once per their genuine key.
